_README: Who the player can be. Four main characters, one chosen at New Game.
WRITTEN BY HAND, like rules.json and playtest_level.json. export_data.py
never overwrites it and the canon workbook has no tab for it.
ALL FOUR ARE PLACEHOLDERS. CLAUDE.md lists the protagonist's identity and
party as an open decision. PC01 keeps the stand-in Cameron chose earlier
(Hiro, Frontier Party - Frontier Party is canon, it is OP02 Yuriko
Mayeda's party). PC02-PC04 are neutral stand-ins with no party, so
nothing here invents a character or a party. Replace them freely.
FIELDS, per protagonist:
player_id       PC01-PC04. Also the art ID and the speech ID:
difficulty      "Normal"/"Easy"/"Hard"/"Very Hard" - matches a
label in balance.json's committee_size_bands (Balance
tab, "COMMITTEE SIZE BY DIFFICULTY"). BattleSetup.
_committee_for() reads DataDB.player's own difficulty
to cap a committee's size. Added 2026-09-25.
assets/characters/protagonists/PC01_neutral.png, and
sounds.json's speech table under "PC01".
name_en         Shown on the Office and the New Game screen.
name_jp         Optional small accent beside it.
party           The caucus is this party's caucus ({party} in stage
names). Blank means the stage is just called "Caucus".
blurb           One or two lines for the New Game screen. Blank is fine.
starting_meta   Optional overrides of sanban.json's own starting
values, by the same four names ("Constituency
support", "Reputation", "Funds", "Party support") —
a name left out uses sanban.json's default. Shown on
the New Game screen alongside starting_xp so the
choice is an informed one.
starting_xp     Optional starting XP. 0 (sanban.json has no XP row of
its own) when left out.
default_protagonist is who you are before anyone has been chosen - the
tests, and the browser playtest, which has no New Game screen.
The party matters mechanically later: the workbook note on MOD01 seq 3
says the Caucus rival should be replaced with a same-party opponent once
the protagonist's party is settled.
A DIFFICULTY LADDER, added 2026-09-25 alongside CLAUDE.md §8's crisis
triggers going live (MetaRules.gd / GameState.gd): each protagonist's
starting_meta now genuinely differs, anchored on PC01 keeping sanban.
json's own baseline exactly (so nothing about the DEFAULT protagonist's
behavior changed by adding this). PC02 opens clear of every crisis
trigger; PC03 opens already past the Town Hall's own threshold; PC04
opens past it AND at exactly 0 Party support — funding frozen and the
Steering Committee forced in from the very first level. First-draft
numbers, the same as every other placeholder in this project — a
tuning pass, not a balance decision made here.
